original.target_description: Experiment 3: proportion of source attributions assigned remember judgments; 2 (stereotype-consistent versus stereotype-inconsistent response) × 2 (correct versus incorrect attribution) × 2 (neutral versus conflicting proportion condition) ANOVA, three-way interaction.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing all required correct/incorrect source-attribution cells to the Experiment 3 remember-judgment ANOVA; 19 neutral-proportion and 20 conflicting-proportion participants.
n.exclusions: 48 initially participated (24 per condition). Five neutral-proportion and four conflicting-proportion participants lacked a correct or incorrect response for a particular item and were excluded from this analysis. Analytic n=39 is established from the stated group sizes and exclusions, consistent with F(1, 37); it is not explicitly printed as a standalone N.
n.location: Published p. 470 (PDF p. 11), Method—Participants; p. 472 (PDF p. 13), footnote 6 and target ANOVA.
n.quote: Forty-eight undergraduate students from the University of Vir- … ginia participated in this experiment, with 24 participants in each … of the two conditions. … Four participants in the conflicting proportion condition and 5 individ- … uals in the neutral proportion condition made either no incorrect or no … correct responses for a particular item.

es.location: Published p. 472 (PDF p. 13), Subjective Experience of Correct and Incorrect Source Attributions, first ANOVA paragraph.

p.location: Published p. 472 (PDF p. 13), Subjective Experience of Correct and Incorrect Source Attributions, first ANOVA paragraph, three-way interaction.

replication.target_description: Experiment 3 replication, Response × Accuracy × Proportion interaction in remember judgments

n.exclusions: 15 of 48 excluded for absent correct/incorrect response cells; 13 neutral and 20 conflicting proportion.
n.quote: Because participants who made no incorrect or no correct responses for a particular item had to be excluded, 33 participants were included in this analysis.

es.quote: The three-way interaction between response, accuracy, and proportion was not significant F(1, 31) = .384 , p = .54.

p.quote: The three-way interaction between response, accuracy, and proportion was not significant F(1, 31) = .384 , p = .54.

reported_success.quote: The present replication failed to reproduce Dodson et al’s finding of a significant 2 (response: stereotype consistent vs. stereotype inconsistent) x 2 (accuracy: correct vs. incorrect) x 2 (proportion: neutral vs. conflicting) interaction.
